policy: Human verification is stored separately from generated remuneration text. A review remains valid only while the reviewed text_sha256 matches the current imported official text.
review_method_required: Open the current official MHLW source for the remuneration node
Compare heading, units/rates, conditions, exclusions and hierarchy
Check delegated criteria in separate notices when the text says 別に厚生労働大臣が定める基準
Record the current imported text_sha256 and review date
